employees.basis: approximately 140,800 employees (individuals working full-time or part-time, excluding fixed term employees, interns and co-op employees); 138,200 full-time equivalent positions

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Employees and human capital management
source.quote: As of December 28, 2025 and December 29, 2024 the number of employees was approximately: 2025 2024 Employees (1) 140,800 139,800 Full-time equivalent (FTE) positions (2) 138,200 138,100

payroll.label: annual total compensation of our median-paid employee on a worldwide basis for 2025

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), Ratio of the annual total compensation of the median-paid employee to the CEO
source.quote: The annual total compensation of our median-paid employee on a worldwide basis for 2025 was $91,000. The annual total compensation of our Chief Executive Officer for 2025 was $32,784,511. The ratio of the two amounts for 2025 is 360 to 1 .

notes: Employees: the 10-K's head count of individual employees at December 28, 2025 (140,800); it also reports 138,200 full-time equivalent positions, the figure used in its business description. Contingent workers are excluded. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used (same year as the head count); J&J says it assumed the 8% of employees missing from its compensation database are paid less than the median.
